translations.web: “Now my soul is troubled. What shall I say? ‘Father, save me from this time?’ But I came to this time for this cause.
translations.bsb: Now My soul is troubled, and what shall I say? ‘Father, save Me from this hour’? No, it is for this purpose that I have come to this hour.
translations.kjv: Now is my soul troubled; and what shall I say? Father, save me from this hour: but for this cause came I unto this hour.
translations.asv: Now is my soul troubled; and what shall I say? Father, save me from this hour. But for this cause came I unto this hour.
